findings.reason: W4-08 migration runner (wc-migration-r2 wording): bounded boot pass. Gated steps: at most 8 per boot and a 250 ms HCWorkBudget slice checked only BEFORE each step (the first step always runs); the rest are deferred one per tick (4 ms is a target, not a bound) and their store refuses that boot, never silently. Steps with store "" have no gate and are never deferred: they all run in the boot pass. One step is not preemptible; its worst case is <=4 fixed backup-slot probes plus about a dozen <=8 MiB passes (target read, scratch read, up to four backup-slot reads for reuse or provenance, backup copy+readback, scratch write+readback, commit copy (plus one retry)+readback). No step is registered by default, so the loop body does not run. Offline candidate; native disk latency unverified.

findings.reason: 2026-11-22 B-14 CallLater root review: HCMigrationRunner.HCSchedule arms CallLater(HCTick, HC_TICK_INTERVAL_MS, false) once per step (s_Scheduled latch), so this is one bounded migration step per tick on a boot-only pass: each step does at most 4 fixed backup-slot probes and one read/copy/readback under the 8 MiB raw cap, and the loop body only runs when a migration step is registered (none by default).
